evidence: ReqwestCloudApi::new configures no_proxy(), and the passing ambient_proxy_does_not_intercept_loopback_mint regression supplies HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY, ALL_PROXY, and lowercase variants while observing a direct origin request and no proxy connection.

ReqwestCloudApi::new uses reqwest redirect Policy::none(); valid_cross_authority_redirect_is_rejected_without_target_contact passed with a syntactically valid Location, origin rejection as ResponseRejected, and a target listener that received no connection.

bounded_body preflights Content-Length and enforces cumulative streamed bytes; chunked_response_bound_accepts_exact_limit_and_rejects_one_byte_over passed for exactly 8192 accepted bytes and 8193 rejected bytes, while malformed_oversized_and_mismatched_responses_fail_closed covered oversized Content-Length with InvalidResponse.

mint_uses_one_exact_authenticated_json_post_and_consumes_grant passed with one POST to /v1/realtime/tickets, exactly one Authorization value equal to Bearer access-secret, no Sec-WebSocket-Protocol ticket channel, and Debug output containing neither access-secret nor the distinct minted ticket text.

Production mint_realtime samples unix_now() only after bounded decode and request correlation; the delayed-response integration case passed, and fixed_clock_private_seam_covers_expired_exact_and_excessive_ttl passed expired, exact REALTIME_TICKET_TTL_MS, and excessive-TTL boundaries without retries.

commands.summary: 8 tests passed in the realtime_http integration suite.
